short_description: 南北朝·天下对弈 (Nan-Bei Chao: War of Dynasties) — 单机策略卡牌游戏。以中国南北朝时代为背景，九位历史领袖、63 位史实武将，水墨古风画境。/ Single-player strategy card game set in China's Northern and Southern Dynasties. 9 rulers, 63 generals, ink-wash aesthetics.

pricing.rationale: T1 research recommendation for first-time indie release: USD 4.99 anchors to 'indie/AA historic strategy' segment (Hegemony III $9.99, Age of Civilizations II $9.99, Romance of the Three Kingdoms VIII $29.99, Sengoku Jidai $19.99). Discount-eligible from day one signals long-tail updates. Launch discount 10% off to USD 4.49 for first 2 weeks.
